mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_import_validation_error (upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_type, error_message, raw_value, created_at) SELECT #{uploadId}, row_number, 'feature_name / raw_wkt', 'MISSING_REQUIRED', '필수값(이름, 공간 데이터)이 누락되었습니다.', COALESCE(feature_name, 'NULL') || ' / ' || COALESCE(raw_wkt, 'NULL'), NOW() FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND (feature_name IS NULL OR TRIM(feature_name) = '' OR raw_wkt IS NULL OR TRIM(raw_wkt) = '')

INSERT INTO sd_import_validation_error (upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_type, error_message, raw_value, created_at) SELECT #{uploadId}, row_number, 'raw_wkt', 'INVALID_GEOMETRY', '공간 데이터(WKT)의 형태가 잘못되었습니다. (선 교차, 면 미폐합 등)', raw_wkt, NOW() FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND ST_IsValid(geom_4326) = false

INSERT INTO sd_import_validation_error (upload_id, row_number, column_name, error_type, error_message, raw_value, created_at) SELECT #{uploadId}, row_number, 'raw_wkt', 'OUT_OF_BOUNDS', '데이터가 한국 영토 범위를 벗어났습니다.', raw_wkt, NOW() FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND ST_CoveredBy(geom_4326, ST_MakeEnvelope(124, 33, 132, 39, 4326)) = false
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_upload_temp_feature SET validation_status = 'INVALID', error_message = '필수값(이름, 공간 WKT 데이터)이 누락되었습니다.' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND ( feature_name IS NULL OR TRIM(feature_name) = '' OR raw_wkt IS NULL OR TRIM(raw_wkt) = '' )
UPDATE sd_upload_temp_feature SET geom_4326 = ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText(raw_wkt), 4326) WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND raw_wkt IS NOT NULL

UPDATE sd_upload_temp_feature SET validation_status = 'INVALID', error_message = '공간 데이터(WKT)의 형태가 잘못되었습니다. (선 교차, 면 미폐합 등)' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND ST_IsValid(geom_4326) = false

UPDATE sd_upload_temp_feature SET validation_status = 'INVALID', error_message = '데이터가 한국 영토 범위(경도 124~132, 위도 33~39)를 벗어났습니다.' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING' AND ST_CoveredBy(geom_4326, ST_MakeEnvelope(124, 33, 132, 39, 4326)) = false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'INVALID'
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_upload_temp_feature SET validation_status = 'VALID' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sd_upload_log SET validation_status = 'SUCCESS', -- 🚀 자바에서 개수를 넘겨받을 필요 없이, 현재 임시 테이블에서 합격(VALID)된 개수를 스스로 세어 채웁니다! success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'VALID' ) WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}

UPDATE sd_upload_log SET upload_status = 'FAILED', validation_status = 'FAILED', success_count = total_count - #{errorCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, error_message = '데이터 검증에 실패하여 전체 롤백 처리되었습니다. 에러 내역을 확인해주세요.', finished_at = NOW() WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
UPDATE sd_gis_dataset_file SET stored_filename = '', file_path = '' WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
UPDATE sd_gis_dataset SET status = 'INVALID' WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.select: SELECT error_id AS errorId, upload_id AS uploadId, row_number AS rowNumber, column_name AS columnName, error_type AS errorType, error_message AS errorMessage, raw_value AS rawValue FROM sd_import_validation_error WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY row_number ASC
